page_title: BRE 2-3 FUL | Brentford v Fulham 18/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Jarred Gillett is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Bernd Leno (Fulham).
90+7' The corner kick from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
90+5' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball. Brentford win a corner.
90+4' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
90+3' Kenny Tete (Fulham) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Here comes a substitution. Antonee Robinson is given a rest as he is replaced by Jorge Cuenca (Fulham).

87' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Bernd Leno shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
86' The Brentford players can’t believe it after referee Jarred Gillett signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
85' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
83' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
80' Adama Traore will be replaced by Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham).
78' A crossfield pass from Christian Norgaard (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates.
76' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Kevin Schade will be replaced by Rico Henry (Brentford).
75' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Yegor Yarmolyuk walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).
75' Substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter will be replaced by Igor Thiago (Brentford).
75' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
74' Kevin Schade (Brentford) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
72' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is booked for saying more than Jarred Gillett was willing to tolerate.

70' 2 - 3 The defending players give Harry Wilson (Fulham) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the bottom left corner. Mark Flekken was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 2:3.
70' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
68' 2 - 2 Tom Cairney (Fulham) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joshua King (Fulham) will replace Emile Smith Rowe.
66' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harry Wilson (Fulham) replacing Alex Iwobi.
66' Jarred Gillett shows the yellow card to Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) for a heavy challenge.
65' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.

64' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
63' Substitution. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) on for Michael Kayode.
62' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
58' Kenny Tete (Fulham) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety.
56' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) commits a rough challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
53' Tom Cairney (Fulham) steps up and sends the free kick straight into the defensive wall.
52' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
50' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
48' The foul by Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
46' Sander Berge comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
45+2' Sepp van den Berg (Brentford) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jarred Gillett ignores the protests.
45+1' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner which is cleared.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. The ball goes out of play and Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.
43' 2 - 1 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) receives a killer pass and scores a great goal after finding the back of the net with a simple finish!
41' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
40' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken is prepared and dives to thwart him.
39' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
37' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Yoane Wissa (Brentford) for a tough tackle.
37' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
36' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Brentford manage to earn a corner.
36' Adama Traore (Fulham) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
35' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
34' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
32' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
29' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Bernd Leno leaps out to thwart his attempt.
28' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
27' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Brentford!
26' There's a break in play and referee Jarred Gillett must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Brentford using VAR. This could be interesting!
25' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) is penalised for holding. Jarred Gillett signals a set piece. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Brentford!

22' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Yoane Wissa slips the ball through to Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
21' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
19' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
18' Rough tackle by Kenny Tete (Fulham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' 0 - 1 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) leaps to meet a beautiful cross and pings a header past the goalkeeper low into the middle of the net.
15' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
14' A yellow card for a tackle by Kenny Tete (Fulham). Jarred Gillett doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

13' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Mark Flekken thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
12' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
11' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
9' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
9' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Sasa Lukic (Fulham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
8' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

7' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
6' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) picks up an injury.
6' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Brentford.
1' Michael Kayode (Brentford) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Jarred Gillett was nominated as the referee for this game.
